messages:
jamie: quick q — i'm about to land a terraform change to add two GPU node pools for the inference cluster: one p5 reserved (steady load) and one p4 spot (burst). main asks: how do we wire the node IAM/profile secret for the new pools, what taints/tolerations do we want, and what's our preferred spot preempt handling? sharing the draft tf below, PTAL.

sasha: put the IAM instance profile on the node group resource directly (node role). for EKS node groups we attach the iam instance profile ARN, no secrets file needed. if using self-managed ASG you need the instance profile on the launch template.

sasha: regarding taints — taint the spot pool like `gpu=spot:NoSchedule` and add tolerations to the inference daemonset + training jobs that can tolerate interruption. keep p5 untainted for latency-sensitive routes.

alix: for spot preempt handling, we rely on the node-termination-handler + graceful drain hook. make sure `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` on critical pods is low and we set a `priorityClass` for controllers we want to keep. also add a fallback routing policy in the service mesh so if spot capacity disappears traffic shifts to reserved. :point_up:

jamie: here's the tf draft i was going to push:
```hcl
resource "aws_eks_node_group" "gpu_reserved_p5" {
  cluster_name    = var.cluster_name
  node_role_arn   = aws_iam_role.gpu_node_role.arn
  instance_types  = ["p5.24xlarge"]
  scaling_config { desired_size = 10 min_size = 5 max_size = 20 }
  labels = { gpu = "reserved" }
}

resource "aws_eks_node_group" "gpu_spot_p4" {
  cluster_name    = var.cluster_name
  node_role_arn   = aws_iam_role.gpu_node_role.arn
  instance_types  = ["p4d.24xlarge"]
  capacity_type   = "SPOT"
  scaling_config { desired_size = 8 min_size = 0 max_size = 40 }
  labels = { gpu = "spot" }
  taints = [{ key = "gpu" value = "spot" effect = "NoSchedule" }]
}
```

morgan: two ops notes — (1) verify AMI/drivers: p5/p4 might need different NVIDIA driver versions; bake separate AMIs or use an AMI that supports both. (2) kernel+nv peer limits: test pod density per node.

frank: i'll pick this up after stand. i'll add nodegroup autoscaler tags and a preempt hook for the spot group in the launch template (spot interruption handler SNS -> lambda -> kube drain). will open PR and tag y'all.

devops-bot: CI pipeline: terraform plan for branch jamie/gpu-pools succeeded — 12 resources to add (node groups, iam role, launch template).

alix: one more: secrets for instance-attach stuff — if you need access to S3 or kms from nodes use instance role with limited policies. avoid baking static creds into userdata. also ensure `ssm:StartSession` is allowed for debugging.

jamie: perfect. frank — when you open the PR can you include the test steps (how to validate driver + pod eviction)? i'll run a chaos test on the spot pool once merged.

frank: yep — will include: smoke deploy, GPU driver check, simulate spot interruption, confirm fallback traffic shift.

sasha: lmk if you want an extra set of eyes on the AMI changes — i've done the p4->p5 compatibility matrix recently.

jamie: thanks all :rocket:
